**apollocrawler.com** is a project in [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md). Its code is written mainly in [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md) (97.7 %), with [CSS](@/glossary/css.md) and [Shell](@/glossary/shell.md).

The [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) was created on 31 January 2014; its latest [commit](@/glossary/commit.md) is from 24 February 2014. It reads “Merge remote-tracking branch 'micro/master'”. With no commit in the last 48 months it is listed as archive: work from 2014, kept for the record and dated as measured.

Its source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/korczis/apollocrawler.com) and [GitLab](https://gitlab.com/korczis/apollocrawler-com).

Related work in [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md): [microcrawler-couchapp](@/work/microcrawler-couchapp.md) (2014), [gooddata-graphql](@/work/gooddata-graphql.md) (2016), [solr-core-minimal](@/work/solr-core-minimal.md) (2014) and [gooddata\_rails\_app](@/work/gooddata-rails-app.md) (2014).
